M-I-001.mitigation: Encrypt data at rest using AES-256

M-I-002.mitigation: Encrypt data in transit using TLS 1.3

M-I-003.mitigation: Implement proper ACLs and role-based access control

M-I-004.mitigation: Implement secure data storage with proper key management

M-I-005.mitigation: Apply data masking for sensitive information

M-I-006.mitigation: Store cryptographic keys and credentials in hardware-protected storage (TPM, Secure Element, HSM)

M-I-007.mitigation: Apply data minimization — expose only necessary registers or topics; filter or aggregate at source

M-I-008.mitigation: Enforce hardware access control on storage (MPU memory protection or encryption-as-access-control)

M-I-009.mitigation: Implement verifiable secure deletion (crypto erase, factory reset, overwrite) for end-of-life and device return
